secure.setupDescription: Garden Desk uses Windows Hyper-V to run tools in an offline virtual machine. Setup grants this Windows account full Hyper-V management access so Garden Desk can run without administrator prompts. Windows will ask for administrator approval once, and you will need to sign out afterward.
